title: GCP-6.5: claim_seq high-water cache - spec requires <=64 entries with LRU eviction; C=8 fail-closed, Rust=256 fail-closed, no LRU anywhere
description: Spec GCP-6.5: claim_seq high-water cache must hold <=64 entries with LRU eviction. C CONFIG_LICHEN_SLOT_CLAIM_SEQ_CACHE_SIZE=8 with fail-closed (rejects unknown gateways when full). Rust uses 256-entry HashMap with fail-closed. Neither implements LRU eviction. Fix: add LRU eviction in both, set capacity to 64 per spec.
